capabilities.title: Read change data with explicit bounds, images and residual filtering
capabilities.brief: CDF uses an explicit build path or DeltaCdfTableProvider rather than IntoFuture. Plan for inclusive version ranges, change images, retention and operation-specific feature restrictions.

choices.choose_when: CDF should be queried as a DataFusion relation
choices.tradeoff: Its scan applies residual row filtering; register it in a compatible context

choices.choose_when: You need a physical plan directly
choices.tradeoff: Execute the returned plan with the appropriate TaskContext and preserve required residual filtering

choices.choose_when: Required historical change data is unavailable
choices.tradeoff: Define a different recovery contract; do not invent missing CDF history

unknowns: An ORDER BY id query over the tiny update fixture encountered DataFusion SinglePartition/UnknownPartitioning(0) planning failure; the unordered query followed by caller sorting succeeded. Timestamp boundary and all enablement-transition combinations are not exhaustively tested.

capabilities.title: Preserve schema meaning across Arrow, Delta and schema evolution
capabilities.brief: Distinguish representation conversion, value casting, schema normalization and table evolution. A successful Arrow conversion does not by itself authorize a Delta write or preserve every Arrow datatype exactly.

choices.choose_when: Appending values without changing table metadata
choices.tradeoff: Check actual nullability, nested fields and protocol-dependent types

choices.choose_when: Additive source fields should evolve the table
choices.tradeoff: Existing rows need compatible missing-field/null behavior; mapped tables have extra restrictions

choices.choose_when: A full replacement also changes schema
choices.tradeoff: Requires overwrite mode and operation-specific validation

choices.choose_when: You need a schema at the integration boundary
choices.tradeoff: Conversion errors and normalization are separate from row-value casting

unknowns: The local controls cover additive nullable fields, string/integer casts, a nested decimal schema, unsigned schema conversion and timestamp normalization. Every value-range, timezone and nested evolution combination is not certified.

capabilities.title: Use kernel snapshots, scans and engine interfaces at the correct layer
capabilities.brief: Use high-level DeltaTable operations for normal table work. Use the kernel and engine interfaces when implementing a scan/engine boundary and when prepared to honor its selection, schema and protocol contracts.

choices.choose_when: The task is querying or mutating a Delta table
choices.tradeoff: Already integrates protocol, storage and DataFusion semantics

choices.choose_when: You are implementing engine evaluation/I/O or consuming kernel scan primitives
choices.tradeoff: Own the engine contract and apply selection/deletion semantics correctly

choices.choose_when: The supplied engine implementation fits the integration
choices.tradeoff: Keep its fork/feature/version identity aligned with delta-rs

unknowns: Custom engine correctness and every internal-api surface are unreviewed beyond the selected contracts; no complete custom engine implementation is certified.

crate_routes.role: Protocol, schema, snapshot/scan and engine interfaces
crate_routes.representations: Cargo alias delta_kernel; fork commit and internal-api feature must remain explicit

crate_routes.role: Default kernel execution and I/O support
crate_routes.representations: Cargo alias delta_kernel_default_engine; distinguish engine primitives from high-level Delta operations

crate_routes.role: Table state, high-level operations, commits, Delta-aware DataFusion integration
crate_routes.representations: Prefer public operation before custom log actions or internal plans
